description.value:
You know the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofFrost]{Ray of Frost} cantrip. At character levels 3 and 5, you learn @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIceKnife00]{Ice Knife} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFlameBlade]{Flame Blade}, respectively. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each once without a spell slot, regaining that use when you finish a Long Rest; you can also cast them with any spell slots of the appropriate level you have. When you cast Flame Blade with this trait, it deals Cold damage instead of Fire damage. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you select this species).

Foundry Note

Choose the same spellcasting ability for the spells of levels 3 and 5. Change the damage of Flame Blade to Cold in the roll dialog.
